---
title: "Analyzing Americans' Time Use"
author: "Mariana Comartin"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = "data/atus.duckdb")
dbplyr_act <- tbl(con, "activities")
dbplyr_resp <- tbl(con, "respondents")
dbplyr_codes <- tbl(con, "activity_codes")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
activity_avg <- dbplyr_resp |>
  filter(
    day_type == "Weekday",
    employment_status == "Not in labor force"
  ) |>
  inner_join(dbplyr_act, by = "tucaseid") |>
  inner_join(dbplyr_codes, by = "activity_code") |>
  group_by(tucaseid, sex, major_name) |>
  summarize(total_minutes = sum(duration_min, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(sex, major_name) |>
  summarize(mean_minutes = mean(total_minutes, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
hourly_avg <- dbplyr_resp |>
  filter(
    day_type == "Weekday",
    employment_status == "Not in labor force"
  ) |>
  inner_join(dbplyr_act, by = "tucaseid") |>
  inner_join(dbplyr_codes, by = "activity_code") |>
  mutate(hour = start_hhmm %/% 100) |>
  filter(
    hour >= 6,
    hour <= 23,
    major_name %in% c(
      "Personal Care Activities",
      "Household Activities",
      "Eating and Drinking",
      "Socializing, Relaxing, and Leisure"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(tucaseid, sex, hour, major_name) |>
  summarize(total_minutes = sum(duration_min, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(sex, hour, major_name) |>
  summarize(mean_minutes = mean(total_minutes, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  collect()

hourly_avg
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6
activity_avg |>
  filter(major_name != "Data Codes") |>
  mutate(major_name = reorder(major_name, mean_minutes, FUN = mean)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = major_name, y = mean_minutes, fill = sex)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Daily Minutes by Activity Category",
    subtitle = "Weekday respondents not in the labor force",
    x = "Activity category",
    y = "Average minutes per day",
    fill = "Sex",
    caption = "Source: American Time Use Survey"
  )
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6
hourly_avg |>
  mutate(
    clock_hour = if_else(
      hour == 12,
      "12 PM",
      if_else(hour > 12, paste(hour - 12, "PM"), paste(hour, "AM"))
    ),
    clock_hour = factor(clock_hour, levels = unique(clock_hour[order(hour)]))
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = clock_hour, y = mean_minutes, fill = major_name, group = major_name)) +
  geom_area(position = "stack") +
  facet_wrap(~sex) +
  labs(
    title = "How the Day Fills Up",
    subtitle = "Average weekday minutes by activity start hour for non-employed respondents",
    x = "Hour of day",
    y = "Average minutes",
    fill = "Activity category",
    caption = "Source: American Time Use Survey"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
